title: Causal Event-Preserving Semantic Refresh Scheduling Q0
research_question: Can a causal lightweight loop select semantic refresh times that reduce fixed-model detector calls while preserving the full-rate reference event output on held-out source sessions?

problem_boundary.predecessor_question: Whether geometry can correct a semantic-loop risk decision
problem_boundary.q0_question: Whether a lightweight loop can decide when a cached fixed-model semantic result should be refreshed

estimand.primary: Event-level divergence from the full-rate fixed-model reference at a lower semantic-detector call rate
estimand.frame_unit: One source capture frame for causal state transitions
estimand.primary_analysis_unit: Scored truth item / existing event-window membership
estimand.repeated_measurement_rule: Frames are longitudinal repeats within a source session and are not independent event samples

claim_ceiling: With a fixed detector, fixed semantic decision chain, fixed input source, and explicit hold-last propagation model, a policy can approximate the full-rate reference with fewer detector calls. This is not real semantic truth, safety, energy, or product evidence.

inputs.reference: Full-rate CURRENT_FULL_PRODUCTION_TEMPORAL_GEOMETRY trace with real source capture timestamps
inputs.detector_dump: Development-only all-detection dump with detector-output hash parity
inputs.truth: Existing scored event-window membership opened only after simulation for event-level reporting
inputs.fast_features: Optional independent trace declared CURRENT_FRAME_FAST_LOOP_ONLY; absence makes feature-rule and learned arms NOT_EVALUABLE

allowed_at_skipped_frame: The arm's own last semantic snapshot
The arm's own cache age and scheduler state
An independently supplied current-frame-only fast-feature row
forbidden_at_skipped_frame: Features computed from current full-rate detections
state_isolation: No shared full-rate tracker or stable-risk state
causal_rules.r0_limitation: R0 is a cache-hold lower-bound simulator; it is not yet a production tracker or optical-flow propagation implementation

full_rate.policy: Run the reference semantic model at every frame

fixed_time.policy: Refresh when elapsed capture time since the arm's last refresh reaches the interval

age_track_failure.policy: Refresh at max age or independently observed track_failure

feature_rule.policy: Max age, track failure, association ambiguity, image motion, and blur

logistic.policy: Train only on development sessions, validate operating point separately, and test once on held-out source/session
logistic.implementation_status: Interface reserved; no learned result without an independent fast-feature stream and session split

evaluation.required_baseline_comparison: Compare against fixed-period policies at comparable detector-call budgets, not only against full-rate execution
reported_metrics: Detector call count and call rate
Fast-loop/tracker CPU and memory when available
evaluation.uncertainty: Descriptive event/session counts only when source cluster count is small; no frame-level inferential p-values

fail_closed: Any fast feature row not declared current-frame-only
Any arm reads a shared full-rate state
All operating points are dominated by fixed-period baselines
A lower-call policy misses critical reference events beyond a separately justified margin
A learned policy works only on one source/session
Scheduler overhead approaches the saved detector cost
stop_rules.promotion: Q0 success does not authorize Android, power, thermal, cross-device, safety, or paper-mainline claims
